# Worlds Within

> Worlds Within is one persistent world played through many genres, and the engine that makes it. The repo is LLM-first: content is text, every run is repeatable from a seed, and tools let an agent check its own work. The engine (`engine/`) holds the loop, input, audio, graphics data and backends; kits (`kits/`) hold one genre's gameplay rules; games (`games/`) hold content and depend on the engine and kits, never the other way round. Start with `CLAUDE.md` at the root, then the page for the module you are changing.

## Project

- [Root agent instructions](CLAUDE.md): rules every change must follow, and the checks to run before pushing
- [Design](docs/DESIGN.md): what the engine and the game are, and the dependency rule
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): the release plan; check it before adding features

## Modules

- [engine/core](docs/modules/engine-core.md): loop, scenes, input, audio and MML, save, seeded RNG, maths and the renderer contract
- [engine/backends/canvas2d](docs/modules/engine-backends-canvas2d.md): the browser 2D backend and viewport
- [engine/backends/null](docs/modules/engine-backends-null.md): the headless backend that draws nothing
- [engine/sim](docs/modules/engine-sim.md): the headless, deterministic world simulation (placeholder until Engine 0.8)
- [engine/tools](docs/modules/engine-tools.md): the CLI for agents and people (arrives in Engine 0.3)
- [kits/topdown](docs/modules/kits-topdown.md): gameplay rules for a room-based top-down action game
- [games/demo](docs/modules/games-demo.md): the proof-of-life demo game built on the top-down kit

## Reference

- [API cheat sheet](docs/modules/cheat-sheet.md): one page of the public API (placeholder, filled in during Engine 0.3)
- [Skills](docs/modules/skills.md): agent skills for common jobs (placeholder, filled in during Engine 0.3)
